description: OpenTelemetry OTLP log export and distributed tracing for SinkSharp. Send fully-enriched, PII-masked log records via binary Protobuf over gRPC (port 4317) or HTTP (port 4318) to Jaeger, Grafana Loki, Datadog, New Relic, Honeycomb, Azure Monitor, or any OTel Collector. PII masking and enrichment run in-process — your data arrives at the backend clean, structured, and ready to query.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.0 — Initial release

OtlpLogSink (ISink):
• True binary Protobuf export — gRPC (port 4317) and HTTP/Protobuf (port 4318)
• Wire format implemented from scratch using Google.Protobuf primitives
  — same approach as Serilog.Sinks.OpenTelemetry, no third-party proto package
• gRPC path: binary Protobuf framed per the gRPC spec (1-byte flag + 4-byte length)
  with Content-Type application/grpc+proto over HTTP/2
• HTTP path: binary Protobuf with Content-Type application/x-protobuf to /v1/logs
• PII masking runs in-process on the SinkSharp drainer thread before any OTLP write
  — CorrelationId, UserId, RequestPath, ElapsedMs, Environment on every log record
• LogEvent → OTel LogRecord mapping per OTel Log Data Model spec:
  SeverityNumber, SeverityText, Body, log.record.original, code.namespace,
  correlation.id, trace.id, span.id, exception.type/message/stacktrace
• Batching with configurable BatchSize (default 512) and FlushInterval (default 5s)
• Error and Critical events flush immediately — never held in the batch
• Background timer flush — events reach backends within seconds of being emitted
• Retry with exponential back-off (1s → 2s → 4s) on transient failures
• Graceful drain on shutdown — DisposeAsync flushes remaining buffer before exit
• OtlpSuppressingHandler — prevents AddHttpClientInstrumentation from creating
  child spans for the sink's own OTLP export calls

AddSinkSharpTracing():
• Registers OpenTelemetry distributed tracing via configureTracing callback
• Resource attributes (service.name, service.version, deployment.environment)
  set from OtlpLogSinkOptions — one config object for both logs and traces
• Caller adds instrumentation (AspNetCore, HttpClient, SqlClient) and OTLP exporter
  in the callback — package stays independent of specific instrumentation libraries

Supported backends (same OtlpLogSink, zero per-backend code changes):
  Jaeger              http://jaeger:4318             HTTP/Protobuf
  Grafana/Loki        via OTel Collector 4318        HTTP/Protobuf
  Datadog Agent       http://datadog-agent:4317      gRPC
  Datadog OTLP        https://http-intake.logs...    HTTP + DD-API-KEY header
  New Relic           https://otlp.nr-data.net:4317  gRPC + api-key header
  Honeycomb           https://api.honeycomb.io       HTTP + x-honeycomb-team header
  Azure Monitor       via OTel Collector             gRPC or HTTP
  Any OTel Collector  http://otelcol:4317/4318       gRPC or HTTP

Dependencies:
  Google.Protobuf                  3.30.1  — binary Protobuf serialisation
  OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting 1.9.0   — AddSinkSharpTracing() registration
